ground_truth.notes: This is a trail runner building toward Snowbird (8.9mi, ~4,400ft gain). The activity had 1,850ft of gain in 7 miles — that's ~264ft/mile. The race demands ~494ft/mile avg gain. The post-run insight should be goal-tied to the trail race: either (a) acknowledge the vert accumulation and frame it in terms of race prep (e.g. 'building the climbing legs you'll need at Snowbird'), or (b) note that the vert-per-mile today (~264ft/mi) is building toward the race's ~494ft/mi demand. Should NOT give generic HR zone or aerobic base feedback unconnected to the trail goal. Should NOT treat the 11:20/mi pace as slow — on a trail with 1,850ft gain, that's strong effort.
